items.exampleEn: He spoke bitterly about his old job.
items.exampleZh: 他憤恨地談起他以前的工作。

items.exampleEn: There is growing dissatisfaction with the bus service.
items.exampleZh: 大家對公車服務越來越不滿。

items.exampleEn: Driving on the icy mountain road was terrifying.
items.exampleZh: 在結冰的山路上開車真是嚇人。

items.exampleEn: Her drawing skills never fail to amaze me.
items.exampleZh: 她的繪畫功力總是讓我很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: The old car, amazingly, still runs well.
items.exampleZh: 那台舊車居然還很好開，真令人驚訝。

items.exampleEn: Mosquitoes are a nuisance in summer.
The waiters worked frantically during the lunch rush.
items.exampleZh: 午餐尖峰時段，服務生們忙得團團轉。

items.exampleEn: Don't freak out; it's only a small spider.
items.exampleZh: 別嚇成這樣，那只是一隻小蜘蛛。

items.sentenceEn: Speaking in front of a thousand people was terrifying.
items.sentenceZh: 在一千個人面前說話真的很可怕。

items.audioEn: Amazingly, the tiny shop sells over two hundred kinds of tea.
items.audioZh: 令人驚訝的是，那家小小的店賣兩百多種茶。
items.questionZh: 那家小店有什麼特別的地方？
options: It has a very wide range of drinks
It sells two hundred cups of coffee a day
The tea there is always free

items.sentenceEn: The two neighbors argued bitterly about the tree between their gardens.
items.sentenceZh: 那兩個鄰居為了兩家院子中間的樹吵得很兇。

items.sentenceEn: The speed of the new train will amaze you.
items.sentenceZh: 新火車的速度會讓你大吃一驚。

items.stemEn: Customers showed their ____ by leaving bad reviews online.
items.stemZh: 顧客在網路上留下負評，表達他們的不滿。

items.stemEn: When it started to rain, people ran ____ to find shelter.
items.stemZh: 開始下雨時，大家慌忙地跑去找地方躲雨。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my friends and I went to a big theme park. We had overestimated how many rides we could do in one day: the longest line was a real nuisance, and we waited almost two hours for one ride. The ride itself was terrifying, and my friend Rina started to freak out before we even reached the top of the first hill. Afterwards, I realized my phone was gone, and I searched frantically under every seat. Amazingly, a worker had found it and kept it safe. Some visitors complained bitterly about the high food prices, and the park later sent a survey to measure their dissatisfaction. Still, the night show amazed everyone, and we all agreed the trip was worth it.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我和朋友去了一座大型主題樂園。我們高估了一天能玩幾項設施：最長的隊伍真的很煩人，我們為了一項設施排了將近兩個小時。那項設施本身很恐怖，我朋友 Rina 還沒爬到第一個坡頂就嚇壞了。之後，我發現手機不見了，在每個座位底下拚命地找。令人驚訝的是，有位工作人員撿到了，還幫我保管好。有些遊客強烈抱怨食物太貴，樂園之後也寄了問卷，了解遊客有多不滿。不過，夜間表演讓大家都很驚嘆，我們都覺得這趟很值得。

questions.questionZh: 作者的手機後來怎麼了？
options: 掉進遊樂設施底下再也找不回來
被工作人員撿到並保管好

questions.questionZh: 有些遊客為什麼強烈抱怨？
options: 夜間表演的時間比預期短很多

items.promptZh: 那部電影的最後一幕很嚇人。
referenceEn: The last scene of the film was terrifying.
The final scene of that movie is terrifying.
rubricZh: terrifying 的用法，例如 was terrifying、is terrifying 等
時態合理（例如 was、is 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 nuisance 造一個句子，說說一件讓你覺得很煩或很麻煩的事。
referenceEn: The noise from the building site next door is a nuisance.
Having to charge my phone twice a day is a real nuisance.
rubricZh: nuisance 的用法，例如 a nuisance、a real nuisance 等
時態合理（例如 is 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：首句因果不通："We had overestimated how many rides we could do..., because the longest line was a real nuisance"——排隊太久是「玩不了那麼多項」的原因，不是「高估」的原因；建議改成 "We had overestimated how many rides we could do in one day: the longest line was a real nuisance..." 或用 so 改寫。passageZh 同步。
